flags: D88 (e): 'median floors ... of 30.5 to 32.6 C in 2019-01-24'; the largest is 32.651356 C (the registered floor_med agrees), which rounds to 32.7. Cosmetic.

D88: 'cells on one protocol swing either 5 to 8 K or 0.5 to 2.6 K' holds for five of the nine validation protocols; four have a cell between (median swings 2.99, 3.81, 3.94, 4.22, 4.75 K) and one cell swings 8.17 K. The ratio gap of rule (b), 0.390 to 0.575, holds; no flag depends on the sentence.

D93 (6) says B and C use the same draws; the registered B2 draws its own resample (s6_parts.py resistance_part, seed [20261116, k + 100]). Same scheme, intervals agree within Monte Carlo spread, C2 uses shared draws; no point or verdict depends on it.
D93 (7) 'every slope divided by r_oe' is ambiguous; the registered divides s_w, s_b and B2's lever, points only. r_oe = 0.99998, so nothing turns on it.
D88 (c) to (e) must be read inside cycles 2 to 100; with cycle 1 (a zero placeholder in 2017-05-12) every 2017-05-12 cell would be flagged. Both codes read the window.
D91 does not state the permutation p's form (the registered uses (k + 1) / (n + 1)) and 'every two batches' means every pair of batches (108 pairs). Readings match.
D94 (2): the literal MATLAB label is 1 for every 2017-05-12 cell; D97 (1) corrects it; my frozen reading agrees (differs from L only for 2019-01-24 channels 45 and 48). Not used.
